name: Agentic Fabric Source Assignment for Onboarding
description: Sent to an assignee when an admin assigns them a source to onboard.
subject: $data.adminName has assigned you a source for onboarding
body:
Source assigned for onboarding

Dear $data.userName,

$data.adminName has assigned the $data.sourceName source to you to onboard within $__global.productName.

Assignment details

  • Onboarding $data.sourceName allows your organization to configure and manage data from that source.
  • When you have finished configuring $data.sourceName, submit it to complete setup.
#set($assignedSourcesUrl = "${__global.productUrl}${data.deepLink}") #if($data.deepLink && $data.deepLink.startsWith('http')) #set($assignedSourcesUrl = $data.deepLink) #end

Go to your assigned sources to begin configuring the $data.sourceName source. Contact your administrator with any questions, or refer to the $__global.productName documentation.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
